audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that Zaahen wins 52.03% over 2418 games while the chart gives Yone 4 of 7 stages and Zaahen 0. Both layers agree with each other and with the packet chart, and the mirror deliberately changed no rows because the direction of the fix is not derivable from the data.
audit.why: Guessing a flip here would create a cross-layer or cross-direction disagreement for no verified reason.
audit.corrected: No side edits; raised in questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fate Sealed was described as 'a wide knock-up dash that both engages and executes', and no cooldown was given for it or for Soul Unbound.
audit.why: Riot's text: he blinks behind the last champion in a line and the slash pulls all enemies hit toward him — no airborne, no execute component. It is 120/100/80s. Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s, the longest cooldown in his kit and therefore the real spike to play around.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text and whys[4] rewritten with the pull, the 120s and the 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanics were stated that the kits do not support: Zaahen's R used as an answer/peel for an engage (it has no CC), Spirit Cleave called 'built-in armour/MR shred' (it cleaves and shields, and its cooldown and cast time scale with attack speed), and Soul Unbound framed as 'reduced damage taken' (Riot's text says the spirit repeats a portion of the damage he dealt on return).
audit.why: Each one sends you into a fight expecting an effect that will not happen. The genuine interaction is that his spirit is forced back to the body, which is a fixed location you can meet with the 850-range W pull.
audit.corrected: spikes[2], spikes[3], late, wants.foe[1], all three dos, all three donts and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns used a placeholder and no numbers.
audit.why: Soul Unbound's 22s at rank 1 is the punishable window; Mortal Steel's 4s and Fate Sealed's 120s frame the rest.

edits.before: Level 6 is even — your R Final Retribution answers his Fate Sealed all-in if held.
edits.after: Level 6 is even — Fate Sealed pulls you in, and your R heals off the damage back.

edits.before: Yone's early strength is his Q (Mortal Steel) third-hit knock-up plus dashing in and out of you with his spirit form on E (Soul Unbound). He can Q-dash onto you, poke, and rewind out before you land your slow E Golden Onslaught engage. Space so his Q3 dash has no range and don't trade while his E is active — he takes only a fraction of the damage back.
edits.after: Yone's early strength is Mortal Steel (Q, 4s, 450 range), which dashes him in with an airborne on the second stack, plus Soul Unbound (E) to trade and rewind away. Space so the Q dash falls short, and count his E — 22 seconds at rank 1 is the longest cooldown in his kit, and the window while it is down is the only time he cannot rewind out of your dash and pull.

edits.before: His R (Fate Sealed) is a wide knock-up dash that both engages and executes; comboed with Q3 knock-up and E recall it's a full kill pattern. Keep your minions between you and hold R Final Retribution to answer his all-in rather than opening with it.
edits.after: Fate Sealed (R, 120s at rank 1) blinks him behind the last champion in a line and pulls everyone it hits toward him — it is not a knock-up and it does not execute. Keep a minion behind you so the line ends elsewhere, and hold your R for the damage and heal after he lands.

edits.before: Yone's first-item spike (crit/on-hit) plus his built-in armour/MR shred W and double-crit makes him out-duel you on cooldown. Don't take even trades when his E and Q3 are up; poke and disengage.
edits.after: Yone's first-item spike plus his double-crit passive makes him out-duel you on cooldown. Spirit Cleave shields him and speeds up with his attack speed, so refuse even trades while his E is up; poke and disengage.

edits.before: Two items in, Yone's E rewind erases his mistakes and his R is a reliable engage/pick — your telegraphed E is easy to dodge. Group, peel with R Final Retribution, and avoid isolated sidelane duels.
edits.after: Two items in, Yone's E rewind erases his mistakes and his R is a reliable engage — your telegraphed dash is easy to read. Group, spend R for its damage and heal rather than as peel, and avoid isolated sidelane duels.

edits.before: With items Yone's crit, built-in shred and E rewind make him a slippery duelist who erases bad trades and picks with R. Don't chase in the sidelane — group, hold R Final Retribution for his engage, and let your team punish the champion he can't rewind away from.
edits.after: With items Yone's crit and E rewind make him a slippery duelist who erases bad trades and picks with R. Don't chase in the sidelane — group, spend your R for its damage and heal once he has committed, and let your team punish the champion he cannot rewind away from.

edits.before: Use E spirit form to trade at reduced damage taken
edits.after: Use E spirit form, then repeat the damage on recall

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Combo there. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 — while it is down he cannot rewind out.

edits.before: Probe Yone's pattern early, then commit your full combo only on his key cooldown — bank knowledge before blood.
edits.after: Mortal Steel is 4s and 450 range; the second stack dashes him in, so hold your gap until that stack expires.

edits.before: Yone wastes Soul Unbound — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His spirit is forced back to the body — meet it there with the W pull.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Q dashes him to you at two stacks — break the chain by stepping out after the first.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His spirit repeats a portion of its damage when it snaps back.

edits.before: Coin-flipping into an unknown matchup — respect what you have not seen until you have seen it twice.
edits.after: His Q dash, his E rewind and a 1000-range R all get him out — chase and you fight all three.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — He snaps back when it ends. Combo there. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1 — he cannot rewind while it is down, so that is your window. - Mortal Steel: 4s, 450 range, dashes in at two stacks. - Fate Sealed: 120s, a pull rather than a knock-up. - Your R: kill windows.

notes: Fate Sealed was described as a knock-up that executes; Riot's text is a blink behind the last champion in a line with a pull. Spirit Cleave was described as armour/MR shred; it cleaves and shields, scaling its cooldown and cast time with attack speed. Zaahen's R was again used as peel/answer — it has no CC. Chart sides left alone: the packet flags a win-rate contradiction but the mirror also declined to guess a direction.
